events.title: Demo Is Out!
events.summary: Warm greetings, fellow bakers 🎄The Christmas Bakeshop Demo is finally here for the Steam Cooking Fest! Hope you have as much fun playing as I did creating the game! Feedback is very welcome both in Steam discussions or on our discord.In the demo there are 6 achievements, you can explore the small mountain village and of course set up shop and start selling the first 8 items. events.title: The Christmas Bakeshop Playtest
events.summary: Greetings, fellow bakers! Christmas is coming, and to celebrate we are organizing a private playtest on our discord. Join with the link below and receive your free Steam key to play right now! https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ We plan to release The Christmas Bakeshop next year, so this is a good opportunity to shape the game.
